title: Number of Ways of Cutting a Pizza
goal: Count ordered ways to cut a pizza into k pieces so every piece contains an apple.
strategy: Suffix apple counts test whether the top or left piece being handed away contains an apple. DP counts ways to continue cutting the remaining lower-right rectangle into the remaining pieces.
